description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment (S96a) to planning permission ref: 204654FUL dated: 25.05.2022 for 'Redevelopment of land at the rear of Nos 11 to 15 The Mall to provide a 9 storey building with basement, comprising 34 self-contained flats , (following part demolition of the existing extensions and structures to the rear of Nos. 11 to 15); Proposed E(b) Use (Restaurant) at basement; Existing E(b) Restaurant Use at ground floor of No. 13 The Mall to be extended into the rear of No. 12, change of use of ground floor of No. 12 The Mall from Retail to Residential (to form Entrance Lobby to Flats), to include alteration to front facade; alterations to existing air extract plant at Nos. 11, 12 and 13; bicycle, refuse and recycling stores (Part Retrospective)'. Amendment seeks change of application description to "Redevelopment of land at the rear of Nos 11 to 15 The Mall to provide a 9 storey with basement, comprising 44 self-contained flats, (following part demolition of the existing extensions and structures to the rear No. 11 to 15): Proposed Class E at basement: Existing Class E ground floor No. 13 The Mall to be extended into the rear of No. 12, change of use of ground floor of No. 12 The Mall from Retail to Residential (to form Entrance Lobby to Flats), to included alterations to front facade; alterations to existing air extract plant at Nos 11,12 and 13; bicycles, refuse and recycling stores (Part Retrospective)."
